name: fp_backup_agent_sweep
label: false_positive
description: A backup agent reading across the filesystem on schedule, including paths that hold credentials, under its own service account.
detectable_as: Looks like collection and staging. The volume and breadth of file access match exfiltration preparation.
why_hard: File access breadth is the signal most collection detections use, and a backup agent maximises it by design. Suppressing it by account name is what most sites end up doing.
